messages:
Priya: Heads-up — prepping a pre-renewal cost health check for Orion (mid-market). Goal: 90d spend forecast, token econ summary, and a short enablement deck covering high-cost patterns. Need ownership for each piece. @Dan can you pull the forecast and top prompt patterns?
Dan: Yep, I can pull 90d burn + daily token rate. Will output a simple forecast + peak-day callouts by EOD. Any target thresholds we should highlight for the QBR?
Priya: Thanks. For thresholds, flag anything >20% month-over-month burn or >$5k unexpected month. Also highlight unusual prompt families (long-context summarization, embedding bulk jobs).
Marta: I can run quick prompt evals and tag high-cost templates. Drop a sample prompt set and I’ll triage cost/perf tradeoffs.
Priya: Pasting sample prompts to triage:
```
Prompt A: "Summarize 30k token transcript into 5 bullet TL;DRs."
Prompt B: "Generate 50 personalized emails using user profile (few-shot examples)."
Prompt C: "Embed 10k documents in batch for semantic search."
Prompt D: "Interactive code assistant with long system + user context (8k tokens)."
```
Dan: Good examples. My quick back-of-envelope from the billing view: current MRR $11.8k, avg tokens/day ~1.1M, estimated monthly inference cost ~$3.3k. I’ll provide a proper forecast csv and a small table of top 5 prompt families by token share. Link once uploaded: https://redwood.internal/forecasts/1782504321
billing-bot: Forecast CSV uploaded to /team-shared/orion/forecasts/1782504321.csv (link above) 
Shane: Quick ask on enablement — I can run a 30-min QBR enablement demo next Tue or Wed. Which day works for the account team and SE?
Priya: Prefer Wed 10am PT. @Marta can you lead the high-cost mitigation section? @Dan bring the numbers.
Marta: I’ll cover batching, prefix caching, and prompt templating. Will prepare 2-3 playbook items:
- short-term: throttle/quotas + alerting
- mid-term: auto-batching + quantization suggestions
- long-term: rewrite heavy prompts or move offline embedding jobs to scheduled windows
Dan: Forecast attached in that csv includes a simple scenario model (base / +20% activation / -10% optimization). Snippet:
```
Scenario, EstMonthlyCost
Base, $3,300
Activation+20%, $3,960
Optimized-10%, $2,970
```
Priya: Perfect. We also need a pre-QBR customer-facing one-pager summarizing risk + asks. Can someone draft a short blurb with top 3 actions and needed support (e.g., quota bump, dev time for prompt rework)?
Shane: I’ll draft the one-pager with the team. Will post a WIP in #customer-docs by tomorrow.
Marta: Also setting two budget alerts in the Console: one at +15% month-to-date and one at +30% absolute. Will tag account owners for both.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Prep sync for Orion QBR — Wed 10:00 PT. Calendar invite created and shared with participants.
Priya: Final ask — capture any customer feedback about model quality vs cost tradeoffs during enablement. We want to log 2 example prompts they’d accept lower fidelity on to save tokens.
Dan: I’ll add a small survey at the top of the enablement deck.
Priya: Great — thanks everyone. If any surprises pop in the forecast thread the next 24h, ping here. :thumbsup:
